newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Heavy up as investors buy low-price shares.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Heavy up as investors buy low-price shares.

text.p: Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd shares climbed in mid-morning trade on Tuesday, as investors targeted lower-priced issues with solid business prospects, brokers said.
As of 0121 GMT, the car maker shares were up 11 yen at 600, with turnover totalling 4.108 million shares. It was the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
Brokers said that recent high-flying blue-chips such as Honda Motor Co Ltd were weak today, due to selling stemming from profit-taking and year-end related sales.
Buyer attention was turning to lower-priced shares, such as Fuji Heavy, instead, they added.
